list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Alternate Dimension 2.1.1 - Backpacks and Bugfixes
- Fixed a very bad bug with the backpack curio slots by just removing them. - Added Backpacks as a gear part that can be added to chestplates! - Added the Vest part, made from string materials, that can be made into armor with only an accessory - no need for a lining. BUT, there's less armor and durability in exchange. It is also cheaper to craft both the blueprint and the part. - Added Enchanted Linen as a second tier to Cloth-related things. Enchants items with Efficiency 2 and can be made into a bigger backpack! - Renamed the old backpacks to "satchels;" did not remove them because they are still useful.

task.summary: - Finished implementing Hallowed one and made Void and Hallowed mobs attack each other. - Added some new Hallowed items. - Removed vanilla mobs & structures from biome spawn lists. - Made Elves and Corrupted Elves attack each other. - Added the first five AltDim OST tracks: Fallen Hero, Lost Ruins, Outcast, Fading Away, and Final Struggle. - Converted more vanilla blocks/items to custom versions. - Added & fixed custom crafting tables for different woods. - Added Romans, Vikings, their drops, and their reputation mechanic. - Added wooden tools for all wood types. - Added Phosphorium and Phosphorium Tools. - Rebalanced ore generation. - Added custom furnaces for each strata type. - Migrated glass and bowls over to custom ones. - Added new mobs and structures. - Tweaked recipes and loot tables to further migrate away from vanilla blocks and items. - Added more custom alternatives for vanilla stuff. - Added (buggy) aluminum buckets. - Added decorative platform blocks. - Added Beetle Queen and beetle variants, as well as the Scorched Tower. - Fixed many bugs

- Deleted Ice Cream Hills & Candy Forest Biomes - Deleted Sugar Blocks and Chocolate Bar - Somewhat fixed the candy jetpack - Made some changes to worldgen - Fixed the Roman Spear - Added Shroomium Tools and made Shroomium Ore only breakable with mushy tools. - Added Graphite Rod. - Added Bow Utility procedures. - Added Planet Core. - Various minor changes and fixes.

- Did a full refactor after merging from remote dev. - Fully fixed Instatunnel and added Instavator. - Added textures for pulling stages of Scorched Bow. - Made Umberflower generate naturally, and made a recipe to convert it to black dye. - Added Possessed Armor entity. - Added stone-tier tools for shale, veridium, and mantle. - Made various changes and fixes after the first playtest. - Added the Greenwood wood set.

- Added the Spore Spreader mob and Shroomy Infection effect. - Made rings dynamic rather than hardcoded and made a dynamic data component/recipe manager for them. - Fixed the spawning of many mobs and the Ability goals. - Various other minor fixes and changes.
- Refactored workspace to 2026.2 and Minecraft Neoforge 26.1.2. - Added many zombie variants. - Added the Blood Moon and support for other world events. - Other various minor fixes and changes.

- Added many new materials and items, including Mana Stones, Mana Crystals, and tech components like Mana Coils and Circuits, importers, exporters, and drivetrain belts. - Completely deleted the old machine system and reimplemented a new, better, more user- and automation-friendly system based around "mana." - Added two new structures to partly replace the deleted Pasta Mall. - Removed the Hexagem Complex and derivatives. - Made the recipes for the high-tier math weapons harder to get, requiring Aluminum and/or Mana Stones - Added physical blocks for Lemons and Limes, and made them and the Pear growth generate on Lush Forest trees and a new Fruit tree in the Fruity Gardens - Half-implemented the Blue Moon event - no special moon texture yet, but blue fog. - Buffed the portal wand recipe. - Added four new gems with their own gem blocks - Added the Iron Giant boss. - Added the Crude Salve and Crude Bandage - Added flesh drops for all the new zombie variants - Added two new flowers: the Cheeseflower and Magister's Bloom - Added Evilstone and Holystone tools, which give damage buffs to Hallowed and Void mobs, respectively. - Added three new spider variants: the Hydra, Venomous, and Incendiary spiders, each with their own special abilities. - Added the wooden club and a simple upgrade using venom glands, another new item. - Finally implemented a graphite rod recipe. - Added a Gem ore that drops a random gem, rather than the geodes (which were deleted) - Finally added a use for corn: Popcorn! - Many, many, many other minor fixes and changes.
- Fixed a significant bug with gravestones and death. - Made some minor changes to creative tab icons. - Removed the choice for vanilla - AltDim mode is now the only mode.
- Deleted the scorched bow because it was causing problems.
- Deleted the scorched bow because it was causing problems.
- Added wall torch models and improved torch placement. - Reorganized some creative tabs. - Added the Cryonic Scimitar and Aluminum Storage Module.

- Ported the entire spell system from SpellCaster API, including the wands, scrolls, and defaults spells, but not the datapack loading, commands, or extra firecharge functionality. - Finally fixed ring recipes! - Added the Viking Tower, Viking Ship, Hollow Candy Cane, Machine Ruins, and Mushroom Cottage structures, further improving the structure variety in the mod. - Fixed various other bugs and made other minor changes.

- Added Math Essence and changed math material/weapon recipes accordingly - Removed the Hint Book and replaced it with a placeholder guidebook for later. - Added Aluminum, Titanium, Uranium, Evilstone, Mana Crystal, Quartz, and Mythril cows - Added the Axiomorph mob, a unique randomized mob. - Added the Willow (rare tree), Brimwood (creative-only), and Solar (rare tree) wood sets - Added Ore essence and duplication recipes for all ores using it. - Added the (mini?)boss HEROZOMBRINE - Added a couple of missing items, such as a Shroomy Box and Candyfloss tools. - Nerfed almost every mob in the game, especially Chefs and Waiters. - Removed the Electrified Spider's super-overpowered ability. - Finally fixed the aluminum storage module and added sound effects for opening/closing containers. - Added more slots to boxes (same as a normal chest now) and essence pouches (for the new essences). - Made mobs not drop any essences anymore, adding Goodie Bags as a replacement (see below) - Added Goodie Bags for each mob "category" (dark, light, ice, fire, life, candy, etc.), along with some generic ones, that drop from certain mobs and can be opened later to receive a bit of loot; this is an attempt to fix the inventory problem. - Made a new title that better fits the post-revamp state - Added the Extractor to complement the Collector, with a filter option and whitelist/blacklist option. - Added filter and whitelist/blacklist options for the Collector as well and made it so it can spit items directly onto conveyors rather than only into other machines - full automation is now possible! - Made a new panorama and title/icon for the new update! - Added darksteel (made using dark essence) and added it to Umbral goodie bag accordingly. - Added more metal cows and added gem chickens! - Various other minor fixes and changes.

2.1.0 Alpha 3: DYNAMIC TOOL SYSTEM!
- Continued working on the dynamic tool system - its practically finished! All the features are detailed below: - Blueprint and part crafting recipes, with JEI support. - Tool assembly recipes. - Incredibly dynamic material and gear type system. - Addition of gear materials for all wood types, mushrooms, metals, and alloys. - Addition of gear archetypes for tools armor, rings, and drills. - Addition of part types for all base tools, tool rods and rod caps, ring bands and settings, battleaxe heads, hammer heads, grips, armor plating, armor lining, and drill engines/heads. - Addition of Curios API as an (optional) dependency. - Addition of material and gear type tags for utility. - Dynamic rendering, naming, and tooltip info. - Armor rendering, Curios API support, and more! - Support for many dynamic features. - Removal of previously hardcoded tools, weapons, and armor. - This is just the beginning! More stuff and removals of previously hardcoded features to come, as well as integration with the ring system and spellcasting system. - Various other minor changes and fixes.

2.1.0 Alpha 4: Tool System Improvements
- Added repair kits to dynamically repair modular items and a whole modular durability system. - Various fixes and changes to improve UX. - Changed many of the materials and added a new Scorched Earth material. - Finished removing hardcoded tools completely. Everything is now part of the dynamic tool system. - Made the basic backpack significantly cheaper to ACTUALLY fix the inventory system. - Halved the Grace time upon spawning to balance always getting it, even when respawning. - Various other minor changes and fixes.
Bumped the version to 2.1.0a4.

Alternate Dimension 2.1.0 Alpha 5 - Jetpacks!
- Added the Jetpack Thrusters gear part type that you can attach to chestplates to fly! Support for different stats, fuel types, and fuel usage values, and uses a similar control scheme to Iron Jetpacks, with a separate engine and hover toggle. - Made more inventory improvements by adding a Backpack curio slot and a Pouch curio slot, with keybinds to open them. Also added Combo Pouch that is a combination of the Essence Pouch and Hunter's Pouch. - Removed the magic system (to be reimplemented later) and removed the now-part-of-the-tool-system effect rings. - Changed the ring effects of all gems to grant effects, and made many fixes and changes to the PermanentEffectsComponent (now known as PermanentCurioEffectsComponent). - Added club head and club dipping gear parts, and added a venom gland material as a test material for club dippings. - Removed hardcoded clubs and hardcoded graphite rods, in lieu of the dynamic ones. - Minor changes to some materials. - Various other minor changes and fixes.

Alternate Dimension 2.1.0
- Bumped the version. - Regenerated the code. - Updated the splash texts. - Basically no other changes since alpha 6.
